what: Both models (base allenai/Olmo-3-1025-7B, RL allenai/Olmo-3.1-7B-RL-Zero-Math) run with teacher forcing over the 1,000 stored T1 and T2 answers; per-position log-probs, entropies, KL, top-1 tokens, ranks. Inference only.

job.command: uv run tools/gpu.py submit h100 --hours 0.6 -- "python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.rln5_map --commit e6354d62eb69a066ac3fcde2abb02077dc308843"

smoke.command: uv run tools/gpu.py submit h100 --hours 0.3 -- "python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.rln5_map --n 10 --mid 1 --long 1 --commit e6354d62eb69a066ac3fcde2abb02077dc308843"

controls.identity: max |KL| 0, max |log-prob difference| 0, 0 top-1 differences over 475 positions of 2 answers
controls.cue: median P(cue) after the prompt: base 3.1e-07, RL 0.858 (12 T1 answers)
controls.calibration: mean log-prob of written tokens plus mean entropy: -0.0016 (T1, base), +0.0081 (T2, RL); median |mean log-prob minus the row's stored mean_logprob|: 0.0003 (T1), 0.0002 (T2)
controls.cache_against_oneshot: problem 482, 6,021 positions: mean |difference| 0.0045 nats (base), 0.0045 (RL), max 0.09, no position over 0.25

gpu_cost: 770 s of job wall time on one H100 (173 s smoke + 597 s full), about 13 H100-minutes; container start is not in these numbers. 1 smoke job and 1 full job.

analysis.script: studies/rlneurons/analysis/rln5_map_analyze.py (the version of the commit that adds this folder)
analysis.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --no-project --with numpy --with torch --with transformers==5.22.2 --with huggingface_hub --with jinja2 python -m studies.rlneurons.analysis.rln5_map_analyze runs/sameraslan-1114-135831-c3ec --t1 runs/diag_t1t2/T1.jsonl --t2 runs/diag_t1t2/T2.jsonl --out studies/rlneurons/results/rln5/map-01
analysis.where: laptop: reads the shards and the stored rows, tokenizer files only, no model forward pass

inputs.frozen: studies/rlneurons/data/rln5/map_inputs.json (sha256 and size of T1.jsonl and T2.jsonl, asserted by the job)

large_files.what: 20 shards T1_map_000..009.npz and T2_map_000..009.npz (120 MB together), index.json, identity_check.npz, log
large_files.volume: Modal Volume iterate-runs, folder sameraslan-1114-135831-c3ec/ (workspace of sameraslan)
large_files.laptop: runs/sameraslan-1114-135831-c3ec/ after `uv run tools/gpu.py get sameraslan-1114-135831-c3ec` (not committed)

files.metrics.json: analysis a-e and the verdict on H (keys a, b, c, d, e)
files.examples.json: real items: every group-i answer at its answer-start token (two for H and two against H with full prompt and base answer), a control sample, group iii, the cap-hit positions
files.checks.json: the full job's controls (identity, cue, calibration, cache against one pass) with per-row numbers
files.tokenize_check.json: re-tokenized token count against the stored count for all 1,000 rows
